lesson.meaning: An important or noticeable part, quality, or characteristic of something.
examples: The new software has many useful features, like a dark mode option.
One key feature of our project proposal is its focus on sustainability.
What features are most important to you when buying a new smartphone?
The meeting minutes will feature all the decisions made today.
A strong team spirit is a defining feature of our department's culture.
lesson.memory_tip: Think of 'feature' as something that 'features' prominently, meaning it stands out or is important. It's what makes something special!
